title: SECOND UNIT — Render Farm Ops Wall
description: Importable dashboard for the Grafana track submission. Install this into your own Grafana Cloud stack (Dashboards -> New -> Import -> upload this file) to see the backlot's real Prometheus/Loki/Tempo signal, plus the annotations and incidents SECOND UNIT writes back at runtime.

panels.title: GPU utilization by worker pool
panels.description: This stays GREEN during a low_samples or break_texture condition — the job succeeds normally. That's the whole point: metrics alone cannot see these defects.

panels.title: SECOND UNIT annotations & incidents (written back at runtime)
panels.description: Every annotation and incident here was created by ActuatorAgent after a human approved the plan — this panel is the write-back proof, not a claim.

panels.title: Agent reasoning traces (Tempo)
panels.description: second_unit.* spans — the agent graph's own execution, exported via OTel so it's debuggable the same way any other farm service is.
